thread:
Alex Park: Quick postmortem follow-up from yesterday's partial-response incident. TL;DR: several sessions hit a new client-edge timeout pattern during high concurrency; reconnects worked but left user-visible gaps. I want clear owners + minimal rollout plan so we don't keep seeing this drift.
Maya Iqbal: Thanks Alex. My read — two gaps: (1) client backoff/retry headers aren't honored consistently by the lb layer, (2) server-side ephemeral KV cache expiry is too eager under memory pressure.
Samir Chen: I can take reconnect/backoff work. Plan: add explicit `Retry-After` propagation, clamp client retry windows, and tighten handshake jitter. ETA 10 business days. Will do canary in us-west-2 first. @Eli Gomez will you own the alerting changes? :+1:
Eli Gomez: Yes, I'll own the alerting and synthetic tests. Action items for SRE: add a streaming synthetic that opens 100 concurrent streams for 5m and asserts no partial-chunk > 0.5% and handshake latency < 200ms. I'll push a dashboard and new pager threshold by EOD Friday.
oncall-bot: Incident 2891234567 created: partial-response spike detected, severity P2. Links: https://incidents.redwood/2891234567
Samir Chen: Implementation notes — we'll add a feature flag `enable_strict_retry` to the runtime and a small compatibility shim for older clients. Deploy order: runtime canary -> routing rules -> client config. I propose a 48h canary window with 30% traffic, then 24h at 60%, then full.
Maya Iqbal: For KV expiry: I'll change the eviction threshold and add a defensive per-session tombstone so a partial cache drop doesn't orphan an open stream. ETA 7 days.
Eli Gomez: Monitoring checklist I'm adding:
- new metric `stream.partial_chunk_rate` (per-route), 1m & 5m p50/p95
- `stream.handshake_latency_ms` with spike alert at p95 > 400ms
- synthetic run status + weekly scheduled run results to #incidents
I'll also add a runbook snippet for ops: how to force a reconnect for a session id (`curl -X POST /admin/sessions/<id>/reconnect`).
Alex Park: Ownership table so it's explicit:
- reconnect/backoff propagation: Samir Chen (10bd)
- KV eviction & defensive tombstones: Maya Iqbal (7bd)
- synthetic tests, alerts, runbook: Eli Gomez (3bd)
- rollout coordination + regression evals: Alex Park (blocker review + release signoff)
Samir Chen: Risk notes — the compatibility shim means old clients might get more retries. Need to watch client-side error patterns. I'll add a lightweight header so we can roll it back if we see amplification.
Maya Iqbal: Also found a recurring pattern in logs: when GC spikes on g3 instances, partial chunks increase ~x3. Suggest adding a health check to avoid scheduling high-streaming pods on nodes with GC pressure. Putting that on my backlog, ETA 12bd.
Eli Gomez: Ops schedule: I'll add a recurring 60-day audit for streaming incident metrics and a short retro item in the postmortem board so we can track recurrence. Also creating an oncall play: if partial_chunk_rate > 1% for 5m, escalate to eng-runtime + eng-sre.
Alex Park: Nice. Quick ask for format: please add PR links + perf numbers to this thread when you open them. I want the canary telemetry (latency p95, partial_chunk_rate, cost delta) after each step.
Samir Chen: Will do. Starting a draft branch now: `feat/stream-retry-propagation`. I'll post the canary plan and the small test harness.
Maya Iqbal: Will open KV eviction PR later today and tag Samir for compatibility concerns.
Eli Gomez: I'll create the synthetic test repo and post a run link once the first run completes. Target: first green run before canary starts.
Alex Park: Cool. Let's reconvene in 48 hours with status. If someone needs to shift owners, ping here. :eyes:
